thread:
Priya (oncall): Noticing anomalous increase in customer reports about models returning older versions' outputs since ~14:10 UTC. Appears correlated with CDN cache TTL change pushed at 14:05. Opening incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1987654321
SRE Bot: Alert: cache.stale_rate > 3% (service=hosted-api, region=global). Graph: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/cache/stale-serve?from=now-30m
CacheBot: Change detected: global cache TTL policy updated to 24h -> 7d at 14:03 UTC (policy-id: cache-policy-42). Deployed by automation pipeline.
Diego (devops): Confirmed change. That TTL increase caused edge caches to hold older model artifacts and routing entries. Running global invalidation now (fast purge) and reverting TTL to 24h.
Hana (eng-runtime): We see requests for model:v2 being served with assets/weights from model:v1 in several edge clusters. Some clients report hallucinations and older behavior. We're pushing a hotfix to prefer origin validation on model manifest version mismatch.
Liam (support): Customer impact: ~18 reports, three enterprise customers (EchoBank, MedML, TravelLens) with production regressions. Escalating CS messages and recommending immediate retries with cache-bust header as workaround.
Priya (oncall): Mitigation actions: 1) TTL reverted at 14:18 UTC, 2) global fast purge started at 14:20 UTC, 3) added origin-version-check to gateway to validate model manifest before serving cached artifact. ETA for purge ~6-8 minutes. Please avoid any further cache policy changes.
CacheBot: Fast purge submitted: purge-id=fp-1987. Progress: 60% complete across POPs.
Diego (devops): Purge completed in NA at 14:25 UTC, EU finished 14:28 UTC, APAC finishing now. Observed mismatch errors drop as POPs reconcile.
Hana (eng-runtime): Runtime metric: manifest_version_mismatch errors dropping to baseline by 14:34 UTC in NA/EU. APAC tailing. We'll keep origin-version-check enabled for 24h while we validate.
Liam (support): Sent targeted updates to EchoBank/MedML/TravelLens with mitigation steps and ETA. Logged support incident INC-2026-045 and attached sample traces: #4501,#4502,#4503.
Product Bot: Drafted status page message: "Intermittent incorrect model outputs observed due to cache TTL regression; engineers reverted policy and purged caches. Recovery in progress." Will publish once oncall approves.
Priya (oncall): Preliminary RCA: automation pipeline allowed an unintended global TTL increase without canary. Root cause: missing policy-level gating in cache-control deploy job.
Priya (oncall): Immediate next steps: add canary rollout for cache policies (1% POPs), require manual approval for global TTL >48h, add manifest-version diff check to CDN edge, and schedule postmortem in next 48h: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1987654321/postmortem.
Diego (devops): Follow-ups: add unit tests for policy gating and simulate model rollout + cache lifecycle in CI.
Priya (oncall): Publishing status update now. Marking incident mitigated for regions where purge completed; will keep this thread open until APAC fully reconciles. If you see residual customer issues ping here. :white_check_mark:
